description.narrative: (Nigeria): .. .With FY 2022 funds this activity will:Strengthen governance systems (with a focus on public financial management and procurement, as well as monitoring and evaluation) related to the delivery of services in key sectors; Increase government responsiveness to citizen needs and priorities including provision of services; andImprove government and civil society capacity to manage conflict.This activity will address some of the principal underlying conditions stifling economic growth, stunting human development, and fueling conflict in Nigeria including: poor governance, corruption, weak institutions, and limited basic service delivery at the state and local levels.This multi-sectoral activity will work with selected states and local governments to improve the governance of primary health care and basic education services with emphasis placed on strengthening linkages and information exchange between government units. By enhancing the capacity of local civil society partners to monitor government performance, hold local authorities accountable for prudent expenditure of public resources, and improve the delivery of key services via emphasis on good governance, State2State will improve government responsiveness to citizen needs. Lack of services and inability of government to assist citizens is a driving force of instability in NE and NW Nigeria resulting in conflict, banditry and the disenfranchisement of the general population. This activity aligns closely to key priorities of the Integrated Country Strategy for Nigeria, USAID's CDCS and Goals 1-3 of the 2022-2026 Joint Strategic Plan.
